verdict.rationale: Reclaim's docs describe an in-product Schedule Assistant that 'highlights what needs attention and suggests what to do next' and an AI Assistant chat for planning, prioritizing, and optimizing your schedule. Time analytics on meetings, tasks, and work-life balance are drawn from auto-categorized calendar data. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what insights and suggestions are actually generated, evidence that the analytics are AI-generated rather than plain stats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI suggestion features.
